infra.title: Official Domains
infra.description: Because eepy.page allows users to register arbitrary subdomains, it is possible for abuse to occur. In the case that this happens, it's important to know which domains are part of our official infrastructure. This page lists all of our official domains to help you verify genuine eepy.page services and avoid phishing or impersonation. Unless a domain is explicitly listed below, you can assume that it is user-generated content that has zero connection to official eepy.page services.
